To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a playful approach to religion, inspired by the game shatranj 'al 'arifin', is an innovative approach that can prevent radicalisation of Muslim youth in Europe.
the prevention of radicalization is possible by a playful dialogical approach in a safe space.

(1) a playful dialogical approach in a safe space increases the awareness of young people about religion, its meaning and its positioning; (2) the awareness of young Muslims about religion and its meaning is increased; and (3) this awareness strengthens resilience in their life orientations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
'playful religion', a playful approach to the prevention of radicalization of Muslim youth in Europe.
a playful dialogical approach as a promising tool in the prevention of radicalization of Muslim youth.
the prevention of radicalism in Muslim young people, which is a challenge for education and for the religious community.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the playful approach is a promising tool to strengthen the resilience in Muslim youth in Europe.
the prevention of radicalization of Muslim youth can be successful by means of an innovative, playful, dialogical, and safe encounter in the classroom.
our playful approach is a promising tool in the prevention of radicalising tendencies among young people.

'prevention is better than deradicalisation'.
the playful approach to religion is a promising way to prevent radicalisation.

the prevention of radicalization of Muslim youth is possible and should be implemented as soon as possible.
the prevention of radicalization is not only the task of educators, but that it is a shared responsibility of all members of a democratic society.
